terms.comment: We have found no ancient source. Erasmus writes Nunc grātia grātiam pariat, “now let kindness beget kindness”, in the Querēla pācis (checked against a transcription of the text).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Erasmus, Querela pacis, checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
